# ClaudeMC v1.19.6 — bug fixes & QoL (Minecraft 1.21.1)

A large batch of fixes to issues reported against v1.19.5, plus several
quality-of-life additions to the ClickGUI and HUD.

## Bug fixes

### Velocity (anti-knockback) now works
Intercepts `EntityVelocityUpdateS2CPacket` for the local player and scales the
incoming knockback by the H-Mult / V-Mult settings before it is applied, then
cancels the original packet. Previously the module did nothing.

### Chat overlay: backspace, arrows & double-send
`ScreenMixin.keyPressed` set the return value but did not cancel the vanilla
handler, so Enter/Backspace/arrow keys were processed twice — sending the
message and leaving the text in the box. It now cancels after consuming a key.

### Singleplayer no longer pauses when a ClaudeMC screen opens
`Screen.isPauseScreen()` was renamed to `shouldPause()` in 1.21.1. The ClickGUI
had been updated, but the Macros, Keybinds, Alts, Server-Info and BlockESP
screens still overrode the old name (silently ignored) and therefore paused the
world. All six screens now override `shouldPause()`.

### ESP / OreESP / Tracers visible through walls
All three render paths had a `consumers == null` guard that aborted rendering;
the immediate-mode `RenderUtils` doesn't use the vertex-consumer provider, so
the guard silently blocked every box and line. Removed.

### Tracers now actually draw
Lines started at `Vec3d.ZERO` (the exact camera position) and were clipped by
the near plane. They now originate ~1 block in front of the camera along the
look vector.

### KillAura no longer spams ineffective hits
Respects the 1.9 attack-cooldown (waits for full charge) and uses typed
setting fields so an old saved config can't disable the charge gate.

### Radar
Fixed the dot-rotation maths (forward is now up), added a clear yellow
self-marker and a colour legend, and switched the default anchor to
BottomRight so it no longer overlaps the enabled-module list.

### Movement cleanup
Speed zeroes horizontal velocity on disable, fixing the "glitchy walking"
after toggling movement modules off.

### FakePlayer
Removed the `copyFrom()` call that corrupted entity state; equipment is copied
slot-by-slot and a status message reports success or failure.

### ChatSpammer
`IntervalTicks` is now parsed as a number even when stored as `"200.0"`.

### Companion web app opens reliably
`Desktop.browse()` fails silently on most Linux/Wayland setups. The button now
falls back through `xdg-open` / `open` / `rundll32`, then explicit browsers,
and finally copies the URL to the clipboard. The title-screen button also
prints the URL on-screen.

## New

- **Module search bar** and **alphabetical sorting** within each category.
- **Sliders + type-to-edit** for number settings (drag = slider,
  right-click = type a value, scroll = step).
- **Middle-click a module** to show its description as a tooltip.
- **New categories** — Misc split into **Exploit**, **Chat** and **Utility**.
- **Draggable FPS/TPS/Ping strip** (right-click + drag in-game).
- Close the ClickGUI with the same key that opens it.
